briefing.text: On Nov 10, Information Technology led sector attention on all three platforms: News buzz 87.6 (-0.1 on the day and the week, mentions +13%, sentiment 0.08), X buzz 93.5 (-0.5, mentions +34%, sentiment 0.12) and Reddit buzz 93.3 (-0.5 on the day, +0.6 on the week, mentions -6%, sentiment -0.01), driven by NVDA, CRWV, AMD and MSFT. The biggest Reddit move was Financial Services, buzz +28.3 (+7.6 on the week) on mentions up 250% around VUSXX, FNILX and FZILX; on X, Financial Services buzz rose 6.5 on PAXG and FSKAX mentions up 500%, with sentiment -0.12. Real Estate rose on all three platforms (News +1.4, X +0.7, Reddit +2.0 buzz), while Utilities fell on News (-2.9, mentions -31%) and X (-1.7), and Financials lost 3.2 of News buzz despite mentions up 20%. Health Care slipped on Reddit (-2.5 buzz, mentions -29%, MRNA, CI, NVO).

TTWO #1: CEO said GTA VI pre-orders are tracking far above expectations (positive, 40 of 75 articles); this explains the jump from #8.
SE #2: mostly analyst takeaways and a MercadoLibre piece; little direct news, so ranking rests on X attention and Kalshi KPI markets.
NVDA #3: heavy selloff coverage and a China chip and spy scandal story, 1,398 articles (331 negative vs 218 positive); explains the attention and volume.
SMMT #4: analyst consensus and upside pieces only, 4 articles; the FDA Kalshi market (77%) matters more than the news.
RKLB #5: up 5.4% on a Morgan Stanley note on Neutron, 105 articles; explains the climb from #23.
STUB #6: weak Q3 results and analyst forecast cuts; explains the attention spike.
CRWV #9: up 24.7% with a 3.5-sigma move, 504 articles (mostly positive) plus Jensen Huang leadership chatter; explains the climb from #37.
AFRM #11: Citi upside call versus a downgrade and a break below the 200-day average; mixed, only partly explains the rank.

Take-Two (#1, score 0.96) has attention 2.6 times normal and X attention 2.8 times normal, both at the top percentile, with volume 1.2 times normal and a Kalshi GTA VI pre-order market. Sea Limited (#2, 0.92) ranks on attention 2.5 times and X attention 2.7 times normal and a 1.1-sigma move, with Kalshi KPI markets as the catalyst, though volume is below normal (0.76). Nvidia (#3, 0.86) is led by volume 2.3 times normal, open interest 1.2 times and a 2.9% rise, with attention only 1.2 times normal and X attention below normal, plus KPI-market and Polymarket activity.

notes: Ranks are by the scoring of record (pick_rank, w2). Prices and moves as of the last pull of the day. Facts from public data; not investment advice.
